# CI for kt
```{r}
# Construct (per-year) Gaussian CI for kappa_t using RW-with-drift increments
# Returns a data frame: year, kappa, lower, upper
kappa_ci_df <- function(LCfit, alpha = 0.05, show_plot = TRUE) {
  # Extract kappa and years
  kappa <- as.numeric(LCfit$kt)
  years <- LCfit$years
  
  stopifnot(length(years) == length(kappa))
  if (length(kappa) < 2) stop("Need at least 2 years of kappa_t to estimate increments.")
  if (anyNA(kappa)) stop("kappa_t contains NA; please remove/impute before constructing CI.")
  
  # Increments (RW with drift): y_t = kappa_t - kappa_{t-1}
  y <- diff(kappa)
  
  # Drift estimate (not directly used in the per-year CI band below, but kept for completeness)
  theta_hat <- mean(y)
  
  # Innovations: omega_t = y_t - theta_hat
  omega_hat <- y - theta_hat
  
  # Innovation variance (MLE)
  sigma2_w_hat <- mean(omega_hat^2)
  sigma_w_hat  <- sqrt(sigma2_w_hat)
  
  # Gaussian CI (same width each year under this simple assumption)
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)
  kappa_lower <- kappa - z * sigma_w_hat
  kappa_upper <- kappa + z * sigma_w_hat
  
  kt_df <- data.frame(
    year  = years,
    kappa = kappa,
    lower = kappa_lower,
    upper = kappa_upper
  )
  
  # plot
  p <- ggplot(kt_df, aes(x = year, y = kappa)) +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
          geom_line() +
          labs(
            x = "Year",
            y = "kappa_t",
            title = paste0("GAPC Gaussian RW-based ",
               round((1 - alpha) * 100),
               "% CI for kappa_t (per year)")
          ) +
          theme_minimal()
  if (isTRUE(show_plot)) print(p) 
  
  return(kt_df)
}
```

# CI for CBD
```{r}
# Construct (per-time) Gaussian CI for CBD kappa1_t and kappa2_t
# using RW-with-drift increments (same style as your kappa_ci_df).
#
# Inputs:
#   CBDfit    : fitted StMoMo cbd object (must contain $kt and $years)
#   alpha     : significance level (default 0.05 -> 95% CI)
#   show_plot : TRUE/FALSE; if TRUE, plot kappa1 and kappa2 with CI bands
#
# Outputs:
#   list(kt_df1 = ..., kt_df2 = ...)  (both data.frames with year,kappa,lower,upper)

kappa_ci_df_CBD <- function(CBDfit, alpha = 0.05, show_plot = TRUE) {

  # --- Extract kappa1, kappa2 and years ---
  if (is.null(CBDfit$kt)) stop("CBDfit$kt is missing.")
  if (is.null(CBDfit$years)) stop("CBDfit$years is missing.")

  kappa1 <- as.numeric(CBDfit$kt[1, ])
  kappa2 <- as.numeric(CBDfit$kt[2, ])
  years  <- CBDfit$years

  stopifnot(length(years) == length(kappa1), length(years) == length(kappa2))
  if (length(years) < 2) stop("Need at least 2 time points to estimate increments.")
  if (anyNA(kappa1) || anyNA(kappa2)) stop("kappa contains NA; please remove/impute before constructing CI.")

  # --- RW-with-drift increments ---
  y1 <- diff(kappa1)
  y2 <- diff(kappa2)

  theta_hat1 <- mean(y1)
  theta_hat2 <- mean(y2)

  omega_hat1 <- y1 - theta_hat1
  omega_hat2 <- y2 - theta_hat2

  # Innovation variance (MLE)
  sigma_w_hat1 <- sqrt(mean(omega_hat1^2))
  sigma_w_hat2 <- sqrt(mean(omega_hat2^2))

  # --- Gaussian CI (same-width band under this simple assumption) ---
  z <- qnorm(1 - alpha / 2)

  kappa_lower1 <- kappa1 - z * sigma_w_hat1
  kappa_upper1 <- kappa1 + z * sigma_w_hat1

  kappa_lower2 <- kappa2 - z * sigma_w_hat2
  kappa_upper2 <- kappa2 + z * sigma_w_hat2

  kt_df1 <- data.frame(
    year  = years,
    kappa = kappa1,
    lower = kappa_lower1,
    upper = kappa_upper1
  )

  kt_df2 <- data.frame(
    year  = years,
    kappa = kappa2,
    lower = kappa_lower2,
    upper = kappa_upper2
  )

  # --- Optional plots (base R, similar to what you did before) ---
  if (isTRUE(show_plot)) {
    old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
    on.exit(par(old_par), add = TRUE)

    par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(5, 6, 3, 1))

    # kappa1
    plot(kt_df1$year, kt_df1$kappa, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
         ylim = c(min(kt_df1$lower), max(kt_df1$upper)),
         main = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "with 95% CI"),
         xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
         cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
    lines(kt_df1$year, kt_df1$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    lines(kt_df1$year, kt_df1$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    legend("topright",
           legend = c("kappa1(t)", "95% CI"),
           col = c("black", "gray40"),
           lty = c(1, 2),
           lwd = 2, bty = "n")

    # kappa2
    plot(kt_df2$year, kt_df2$kappa, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
         ylim = c(min(kt_df2$lower), max(kt_df2$upper)),
         main = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)} ~ "with 95% CI"),
         xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)}),
         cex.main = 2, cex.lab = 2, cex.axis = 1.3)
    lines(kt_df2$year, kt_df2$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    lines(kt_df2$year, kt_df2$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
    legend("topright",
           legend = c("kappa2(t)", "95% CI"),
           col = c("black", "gray40"),
           lty = c(1, 2),
           lwd = 2, bty = "n")

    par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
  }

  return(list(kt_df1 = kt_df1, kt_df2 = kt_df2))
}
```

# Parameter Plot for LC
```{r}
# Plot LC ax, bx, kt with (per-year) kappa CI lines
# - Input: LCfit, model name, region name
# - Output: saves PNG image named by model and region
# - Internally calls kappa_ci_df(LCfit, show_plot = FALSE) to get kt_df

plot_lc_components_ci <- function(LCfit, region) {

  # get CI df without plotting
  kt_df <- kappa_ci_df(LCfit, show_plot = FALSE)

  # robust year vector for kt plot
  kt_years <- as.numeric(colnames(LCfit$kt))
  if (anyNA(kt_years)) {
    kt_years <- LCfit$years
  }

  # Build file name from model and region
  file_name <- paste0(region, "_LC_parameters.png")

  # Open PNG device - adjusted height to remove whitespace
  png(file_name, width = 1300, height = 500, res = 120)

  oldpar <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit({
    par(oldpar)
    dev.off()
  }, add = TRUE)

  # Fixed to c(1, 3) since we only have 3 plots
  par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 6, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 3, 0))

  # ax
  plot(25:65, LCfit$ax, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(a[x] ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(a[x]),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)
  axis(1, at = seq(25, 65, by = 5), labels = seq(25, 65, by = 5), cex.axis = 1.1)

  # bx
  plot(25:65, LCfit$bx, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(beta[x]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(beta[x]^{(1)}),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)
  axis(1, at = seq(25, 65, by = 5), labels = seq(25, 65, by = 5), cex.axis = 1.1)

  # kt with CI
  plot(kt_years, LCfit$kt[1, ], type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ t),
       ylim = c(min(kt_df$lower), max(kt_df$upper)),
       xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)

  lines(kt_df$year, kt_df$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  lines(kt_df$year, kt_df$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)

  legend("topright",
         legend = c("kappa(t)", "95% CI"),
         col    = c("black", "gray40"),
         lty    = c(1, 2),
         lwd    = 2,
         bty    = "n")
  
  # Overall title spanning all panels
  mtext(
    paste0("Lee-Carter Model Parameter Estimates — ", region),
    outer = TRUE,
    side  = 3,
    line  = 1,
    cex   = 1.4,
    font  = 2
  )
  
  invisible(NULL)
}
```

# Parameter Plot for RH
```{r}
plot_RHnp_with_kappa_CI <- function(RHnp_fit, region, alpha = 0.05) {

  # --- get kappa CI df (no ggplot shown) ---
  kt_df <- kappa_ci_df(RHnp_fit, alpha = alpha, show_plot = FALSE)

  # --- prepare variables ---
  ages    <- RHnp_fit$ages / 12
  t_years <- as.numeric(colnames(RHnp_fit$kt)) / 12
  kappa1  <- as.numeric(RHnp_fit$kt[1, ])
  cohorts <- as.numeric(names(RHnp_fit$gc)) / 12

  # Build file name from region
  file_name <- paste0(region, "_RH_parameters.png")

  # Open PNG device
  png(file_name, width = 2000, height = 900, res = 120)

  old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
  on.exit({
    graphics::layout(1)
    par(old_par)
    dev.off()
  }, add = TRUE)

  # 5 plots: row 1 = 3 plots, row 2 = 2 plots centered
  layout_mat <- matrix(c(1, 2, 3,
                         0, 4, 5),
                       nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  graphics::layout(layout_mat)
  par(mar = c(5, 6, 3, 1), oma = c(0, 0, 4, 0))

  # 1) ax
  plot(ages, RHnp_fit$ax, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(a[x] ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(a[x]),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)
  axis(1, at     = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5),
           labels = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), cex.axis = 1.1)

  # 2) bx (beta^(1)_x)
  plot(ages, RHnp_fit$bx, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(beta[x]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(beta[x]^{(1)}),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)
  axis(1, at     = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5),
           labels = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), cex.axis = 1.1)

  # 3) kt (kappa^(1)_t) with CI
  plot(t_years, kappa1, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "vs." ~ t),
       ylim = c(min(kt_df$lower), max(kt_df$upper)),
       xlab = "Year", ylab = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)
  lines(t_years, kt_df$lower, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  lines(t_years, kt_df$upper, col = "gray40", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
  legend("topright",
         legend = c("kappa(t)", "95% CI"),
         col    = c("black", "gray40"),
         lty    = c(1, 3),
         lwd    = 2,
         bty    = "n")

  # 4) b0x (beta^(2)_x)
  plot(ages, RHnp_fit$b0x, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(beta[x]^{(2)} ~ "vs." ~ x),
       xlab = "Age", ylab = expression(beta[x]^{(2)}),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)
  axis(1, at     = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5),
           labels = seq(min(ages), max(ages), by = 5), cex.axis = 1.1)

  # 5) gc (gamma_{t-x} vs cohort)
  plot(cohorts, RHnp_fit$gc, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "black",
       main = expression(gamma[t-x] ~ "vs." ~ t-x),
       xlab = "Cohort", ylab = expression(gamma[t-x]),
       cex.main = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.3, cex.axis = 1.1)

  # Overall title spanning all panels
  mtext(
    paste0("Renshaw-Haberman Model Parameter Estimates — ", region),
    outer = TRUE,
    side  = 3,
    line  = 1.5,
    cex   = 1.4,
    font  = 2
  )

  invisible(list(kt_df = kt_df))
}
```

# Parameter Plot for CBD
```{r}
# Plot CBD kappa^(1) and kappa^(2) with CI (ggplot), with x-breaks built from data range
# - x_break_by controls the spacing of breaks (e.g., 5, 10, 20)
plot_CBD_kappa_CI_gg <- function(CBDfit, region, alpha = 0.05,
                                  x_break_by = 5,
                                  base_size   = 12) {
  CBDfit$years <- CBDfit$years/12
  out <- kappa_ci_df_CBD(CBDfit, alpha = alpha, show_plot = FALSE)
  kt_df1 <- out$kt_df1
  kt_df2 <- out$kt_df2

  # Build breaks from data range
  year_min <- floor(min(c(kt_df1$year, kt_df2$year), na.rm = TRUE))
  year_max <- ceiling(max(c(kt_df1$year, kt_df2$year), na.rm = TRUE))
  x_breaks <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = x_break_by)

  p1 <- ggplot(kt_df1, aes(x = year, y = kappa)) +
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = lower), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    geom_line(aes(y = upper), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    labs(
      x = "year",
      y = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)}),
      title = expression(kappa[t]^{(1)} ~ "vs. t")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  p2 <- ggplot(kt_df2, aes(x = year, y = kappa)) +
    geom_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = lower), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    geom_line(aes(y = upper), color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "33") +
    labs(
      x = "year",
      y = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)}),
      title = expression(kappa[t]^{(2)} ~ "vs. t")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = x_breaks) +
    theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text    = element_text(size = 10)
    )

  # ── Combine: 2 columns, 1 row with overall title ───────────────────────────
  combined <- gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    p1, p2,
    ncol = 2,
    top  = grid::textGrob(
      paste0("CBD Model Parameters Estimates — ", region),
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )

  # ── Save ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  ggsave(
    filename = paste0(region, "_CBD_kappa.png"),
    plot     = combined,
    width    = 12,
    height   = 5,
    dpi      = 300
  )
  invisible(list(p1 = p1, p2 = p2, kt_df1 = kt_df1, kt_df2 = kt_df2, x_breaks = x_breaks))
}
```

# RH
```{r}
fit_RH_rr <- function(mort_data){
  max_try <- 10
  mort_data2 <- mort_data
  mort_data2$years <- mort_data$years *12
  mort_data2$ages <- mort_data$ages*12
  # --- track best successful attempt ---
  best_logLik <- -Inf
  best_fitRH <- NULL
  
  RHnp_mod <- rh(link = "log", cohortAgeFun = "NP")

  for (j in seq_len(max_try)) {
    # 1) Try fitting RH 
    fitRH_j <- tryCatch(
      fit(RHnp_mod, data = mort_data2,
          ages.fit = (25:65)*12, control = list(maxit = 200)),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  
    # 2) if fit error -> move on
    if (is.null(fitRH_j) || isTRUE(fitRH_j$fail)) next
    
    ll_j <- fitRH_j$loglik
    if (ll_j > best_logLik) {
    best_logLik <- ll_j
    best_fitRH <- fitRH_j
    }
    
    return(best_fitRH) 
  }
}
```

```{r}
library(parallel)

data_list <- list(
  Midwest   = Midwest_data,

clusterEvalQ(cl, library(StMoMo))

results <- parLapply(cl, data_list, fit_RH_rr)

stopCluster(cl)

# Extract results
RH_Midwest   <- results$Midwest
```

# CBD
```{r}
fit_CBD <- function(mort_data){
  N <- 1e6
  mort_data2 <- mort_data
  mort_data2$Dxt <- round(mort_data$Dxt * N)
  mort_data2$Ext <- round(mort_data$Ext * N)
  mort_data2$years <- mort_data$years*12
  CBD <- cbd(link = "logit")
  CBDfit <- fit(CBD, data =  central2initial(mort_data2), ages.fit = (25:65))
  return(CBDfit)
}
```

# Forecast 
```{r}
get_fc_rates_vec <- function(fc, ages) {
  r <- fc$rates
  if (is.null(dim(r))) {
    v <- r
  } else {
    v <- r[, 1]
  }
  v <- as.numeric(v)
  names(v) <- rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates)) %||% names(fc$rates) # optional, but safer

  # best: just reorder by ages using names when available
  if (!is.null(names(fc$rates)) || !is.null(rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates)))) {
    nm <- if (!is.null(names(fc$rates))) names(fc$rates) else rownames(as.matrix(fc$rates))
    names(v) <- nm
    v <- v[as.character(ages)]
  }
  v
}
```

## LC
### one month ahead
```{r}
## LC
lc_roll_1mo_forecast <- function(mort_data, start_year=2008, end_year=2021) {
  # fixed settings (same as your yearly code)
  ages_fit <- 25:65
  LC <- lc(link = "log", const = "sum")
  mort_data$ages <- ages_fit
  mort_data$Dxt <- mort_data$Dxt[ages_fit,]
  mort_data$Ext <- mort_data$Ext[ages_fit,]
  
  # evaluation months
  time_num <- mort_data$years
  eval_idx <- which(time_num >= start_year & time_num < end_year)
  # for 1-step ahead forecast, origin is previous month (index-based, robust)
  origin_idx <- eval_idx - 1
  
  eval_time   <- time_num[eval_idx]
  origin_time <- time_num[origin_idx]
  
  # — LC CI extraction function (mirrors yearly code) ————————————————
  extract_lc_ci <- function(fitLC, fcLC, ages) {
    ax <- as.numeric(fitLC$ax[as.character(ages)])
    bx <- as.numeric(fitLC$bx[as.character(ages), 1])

    kt_mean  <- as.numeric(fcLC$kt.f$mean)
    kt_lower <- as.numeric(fcLC$kt.f$lower)
    kt_upper <- as.numeric(fcLC$kt.f$upper)

    log_mx_mean  <- ax + bx * kt_mean
    log_mx_upper <- ax + bx * ifelse(bx >= 0, kt_upper, kt_lower)
    log_mx_lower <- ax + bx * ifelse(bx >= 0, kt_lower, kt_upper)

    data.frame(
      age      = ages,
      mx_mean  = exp(log_mx_mean),
      mx_lower = exp(log_mx_lower),
      mx_upper = exp(log_mx_upper)
    )
  }
  
  # forecast rate, output matrices
  mx_hat_lc_rw <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                       dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  
  mx_hat_lc_ar <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                       dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  
  # CI matrices
  mx_hat_lc_rw_lower <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                                dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  mx_hat_lc_rw_upper <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                                dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  mx_hat_lc_ar_lower <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                                dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  mx_hat_lc_ar_upper <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                                dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time)))
  
  for (i in seq_along(eval_idx)) {
    T <- eval_time[i]
    # fit LC with design experience year
    fitLC_f <- fit(LC, data = mort_data, ages.fit = ages_fit, years.fit = time_num[1:origin_idx[i]])
    # check convergence
    print(paste("Year:", T, fitLC_f$conv))
    # one step ahead forecast
    fcLC_rw <- forecast(fitLC_f, h=1, level=95)
    fcLC_ar <- forecast(fitLC_f, h=1, kt.method = "iarima", kt.order = c(1,0,0), level=95)
  
    # extract forecast rate
    mx_hat_lc_rw[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcLC_rw, ages_fit)
    mx_hat_lc_ar[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcLC_ar, ages_fit)
    
    # extract CI rates (mirrors yearly code)
    ci_rw <- extract_lc_ci(fitLC_f, fcLC_rw, ages_fit)
    ci_ar <- extract_lc_ci(fitLC_f, fcLC_ar, ages_fit)

    mx_hat_lc_rw_lower[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- ci_rw$mx_lower
    mx_hat_lc_rw_upper[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- ci_rw$mx_upper
    mx_hat_lc_ar_lower[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- ci_ar$mx_lower
    mx_hat_lc_ar_upper[, as.character(eval_time[i])] <- ci_ar$mx_upper
  }
  
 return(list(
    mx_hat_lc_rw       = mx_hat_lc_rw,
    mx_hat_lc_ar       = mx_hat_lc_ar,
    mx_hat_lc_rw_lower = mx_hat_lc_rw_lower,
    mx_hat_lc_rw_upper = mx_hat_lc_rw_upper,
    mx_hat_lc_ar_lower = mx_hat_lc_ar_lower,
    mx_hat_lc_ar_upper = mx_hat_lc_ar_upper,
    eval_time          = eval_time,
    origin_time        = origin_time
  ))
}
```

## CBD
### One month ahead
```{r}
## CBD
CBD_roll_1mo_forecast <- function(mort_data, start_year=2008, end_year=2021) {
  # fixed settings
  ages_fit <- 25:65
  CBD <- cbd(link = "logit")
  N <- 1e6
  mort_data$Dxt <- round(mort_data$Dxt * N)
  mort_data$Ext <- round(mort_data$Ext * N)
  mort_data$years <- mort_data$years*12
  mort_data$ages <- ages_fit
  mort_data$Dxt <- mort_data$Dxt[ages_fit,]
  mort_data$Ext <- mort_data$Ext[ages_fit,]
  
  # evaluation months
  time_num <- mort_data$years
  eval_idx <- which(time_num >= start_year*12 & time_num < end_year*12)
  # origin is previous month
  origin_idx <- eval_idx - 1
  
  eval_time   <- time_num[eval_idx]
  origin_time <- time_num[origin_idx]
  
  # ── CBD CI extraction function ─────────
  extract_cbd_ci <- function(fitCBD, fcCBD, ages) {
    xbar <- mean(ages)

    kt_mean  <- fcCBD$kt.f$mean
    kt_lower <- fcCBD$kt.f$lower
    kt_upper <- fcCBD$kt.f$upper

    k1_mean  <- as.numeric(kt_mean[1,  ])
    k2_mean  <- as.numeric(kt_mean[2,  ])
    k1_lower <- as.numeric(kt_lower[1, ,])
    k2_lower <- as.numeric(kt_lower[2, ,])
    k1_upper <- as.numeric(kt_upper[1, ,])
    k2_upper <- as.numeric(kt_upper[2, ,])

    logit_mean  <- numeric(length(ages))
    logit_lower <- numeric(length(ages))
    logit_upper <- numeric(length(ages))

    for (idx in seq_along(ages)) {
      x    <- ages[idx]
      coef <- x - xbar   # coefficient for k2

      logit_mean[idx]  <- k1_mean  + coef * k2_mean
      logit_upper[idx] <- k1_upper + coef * ifelse(coef >= 0, k2_upper, k2_lower)
      logit_lower[idx] <- k1_lower + coef * ifelse(coef >= 0, k2_lower, k2_upper)
    }

    inv_logit <- function(x) exp(x) / (1 + exp(x))

    data.frame(
      age      = ages,
      qx_mean  = inv_logit(logit_mean),
      qx_lower = inv_logit(logit_lower),
      qx_upper = inv_logit(logit_upper)
    )
  }

  # forecast rate, output matrices
  qx_hat_CBD <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                     dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit), as.character(eval_time/12)))
  
  qx_hat_CBD_lower <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                              dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit),
                                              as.character(eval_time / 12)))

  qx_hat_CBD_upper <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(ages_fit), ncol = length(eval_idx),
                              dimnames = list(as.character(ages_fit),
                                              as.character(eval_time / 12)))
  # ── Forecast loop 
  for (i in seq_along(eval_idx)) {
    T <- origin_time[i]
    
    # fit LC with design experience year
    fitCBD_f <- fit(CBD, data = central2initial(mort_data), ages.fit = ages_fit, years.fit = time_num[1:origin_idx[i]])
    
    # check convergence
    print(paste("Year:", T/12, fitCBD_f$conv))
    
    # one step ahead forecast
    fcCBD <- forecast(fitCBD_f, h=1, level=95)
  
    # extract forecast rate
    qx_hat_CBD[, as.character(eval_time[i]/12)] <- get_fc_rates_vec(fcCBD, ages_fit)
    
    # CI
    ci_cbd <- extract_cbd_ci(fitCBD_f, fcCBD, ages_fit)

    qx_hat_CBD_lower[, as.character(eval_time[i] / 12)] <- ci_cbd$qx_lower
    qx_hat_CBD_upper[, as.character(eval_time[i] / 12)] <- ci_cbd$qx_upper
  }
  
  return(list(
    qx_hat_CBD       = qx_hat_CBD,
    qx_hat_CBD_lower = qx_hat_CBD_lower,
    qx_hat_CBD_upper = qx_hat_CBD_upper,
    eval_time        = eval_time / 12,
    origin_time      = origin_time / 12
  ))
}
```

# Forecast Result
## West
```{r}
# ── Choose region ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg      <- "West"   # change to "Northeast", "South", or "West"
LC_res   <- LCfor_West    # change accordingly
RH_res   <- RH1021_West    # change accordingly
CBD_res  <- CBDfor_West   # change accordingly
reg_data <- region_data[["West"]]   # change accordingly

# ── Convert CBD qx to mx ──────────────────────────────────────────────
CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD       <- CBD_res$qx_hat_CBD       / (1 - CBD_res$qx_hat_CBD)
CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD_lower <- CBD_res$qx_hat_CBD_lower / (1 - CBD_res$qx_hat_CBD_lower)
CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD_upper <- CBD_res$qx_hat_CBD_upper / (1 - CBD_res$qx_hat_CBD_upper)

# ── Settings ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
rep_ages   <- c(30, 40, 50, 60)
all_evalMonths <- LC_res$eval_time
evalMonths     <- all_evalMonths[all_evalMonths >= 2010 & all_evalMonths < 2020]

# ── Extract observed mx ───────────────────────────────────────────────
yr_char   <- as.character(evalMonths)
obs_death <- reg_data$Dxt[as.character(rep_ages), yr_char, drop = FALSE]
obs_exp   <- reg_data$Ext[as.character(rep_ages), yr_char, drop = FALSE]
obs_mx    <- obs_death / obs_exp

# ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
extract_age_series <- function(mat, age, years) {
  data.frame(
    year = years,
    rate = as.numeric(mat[as.character(age), as.character(years)])
  )
}

extract_age_ci <- function(mat_lower, mat_upper, age, years) {
  data.frame(
    year  = years,
    lower = as.numeric(mat_lower[as.character(age), as.character(years)]),
    upper = as.numeric(mat_upper[as.character(age), as.character(years)])
  )
}

# ── Build plot_data (mean lines) ──────────────────────────────────────
plot_data <- lapply(rep_ages, function(age) {
  bind_rows(
    extract_age_series(obs_mx,               age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Actual"),
    extract_age_series(LC_res$mx_hat_lc_rw,  age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Lee-Carter"),
    extract_age_series(RH_res$mx_hat_rh_ar,  age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Renshaw-Haberman"),
    extract_age_series(CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD,   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "CBD")
  ) %>% mutate(age = paste0("Age ", age))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ── Build ci_data (ribbons) ───────────────────────────────────────────
ci_data <- lapply(rep_ages, function(age) {
  bind_rows(
    extract_age_ci(LC_res$mx_hat_lc_rw_lower,  LC_res$mx_hat_lc_rw_upper,
                   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Lee-Carter"),
    extract_age_ci(RH_res$mx_hat_rh_ar_lower,  RH_res$mx_hat_rh_ar_upper,
                   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Renshaw-Haberman"),
    extract_age_ci(CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD_lower,    CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD_upper,
                   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "CBD")
  ) %>% mutate(age = paste0("Age ", age))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # CI ribbons (behind lines)
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_data,
              aes(x = year, ymin = log(lower), ymax = log(upper), fill = model),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  # Forecast lines
  geom_line(data = filter(plot_data, model != "Actual"),
            aes(x = year, y = log(rate), color = model, linetype = model),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Actual line
  geom_line(data = filter(plot_data, model == "Actual"),
            aes(x = year, y = log(rate), color = model, linetype = model),
            linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ age, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Actual"           = "black",
    "Lee-Carter"       = "#E41A1C",
    "Renshaw-Haberman" = "#377EB8",
    "CBD"              = "#FF7F00"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Actual"           = "black",
    "Lee-Carter"       = "#E41A1C",
    "Renshaw-Haberman" = "#377EB8",
    "CBD"              = "#FF7F00"
  )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Actual"           = "solid",
    "Lee-Carter"       = "dashed",
    "Renshaw-Haberman" = "dotdash",
    "CBD"              = "dotted"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("One-Month Ahead Forecast vs Actual Mortality Rate — ", reg),
    x        = "Month (decimal year)",
    y        = "Log Mortality Rate",
    color    = "Model", linetype = "Model", fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(paste0("monthly_forecast_vs_actual_", reg, ".png"),
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
  bind_rows(
    extract_age_ci(LC_res$mx_hat_lc_rw_lower,  LC_res$mx_hat_lc_rw_upper,
                   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Lee-Carter"),
    extract_age_ci(RH_res$mx_hat_rh_ar_lower,  RH_res$mx_hat_rh_ar_upper,
                   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "Renshaw-Haberman"),
    extract_age_ci(CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD_lower,    CBD_res$mx_hat_CBD_upper,
                   age, evalMonths) %>% mutate(model = "CBD")
  ) %>% mutate(age = paste0("Age ", age))
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot() +
  # CI ribbons (behind lines)
  geom_ribbon(data = ci_data,
              aes(x = year, ymin = log(lower), ymax = log(upper), fill = model),
              alpha = 0.2) +
  # Forecast lines
  geom_line(data = filter(plot_data, model != "Actual"),
            aes(x = year, y = log(rate), color = model, linetype = model),
            linewidth = 0.8) +
  # Actual line
  geom_line(data = filter(plot_data, model == "Actual"),
            aes(x = year, y = log(rate), color = model, linetype = model),
            linewidth = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ age, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Actual"           = "black",
    "Lee-Carter"       = "#E41A1C",
    "Renshaw-Haberman" = "#377EB8",
    "CBD"              = "#FF7F00"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Actual"           = "black",
    "Lee-Carter"       = "#E41A1C",
    "Renshaw-Haberman" = "#377EB8",
    "CBD"              = "#FF7F00"
  )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Actual"           = "solid",
    "Lee-Carter"       = "dashed",
    "Renshaw-Haberman" = "dotdash",
    "CBD"              = "dotted"
  )) +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("One-Month Ahead Forecast vs Actual Mortality Rate — ", reg),
    x        = "Month (decimal year)",
    y        = "Log Mortality Rate",
    color    = "Model", linetype = "Model", fill = "Model"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave(paste0("monthly_forecast_vs_actual_", reg, ".png"),
       width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```

# DM Test
```{r}
# Define loss function 
# Poisson Deviance
poisson_deviance_cell <- function(D, Dhat) {
  # D, Dhat numeric vectors/matrices; returns same shape
  Dhat <- pmax(Dhat, 1e-12)  # avoid division by 0
  out <- 2 * (D * ifelse(D == 0, 0, log(D / Dhat)) - (D - Dhat))
  out
}

# average
loss_per_year_poisson_dev_avg <- function(D_obs, D_hat) {
  dev_mat <- poisson_deviance_cell(D_obs, D_hat)  # age x year
  colMeans(dev_mat, na.rm = TRUE)                  # length T vector (years)
}
```

```{r}
# Define loss function 
# Binomial Deviance
binom_deviance_cell <- function(D, E, qhat) {
  qhat <- pmin(pmax(qhat, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)
  mu <- E * qhat

  term1 <- ifelse(D == 0, 0, D * log(D / mu))
  term2 <- ifelse(D == E, 0, (E - D) * log((E - D) / (E - mu)))

  2 * (term1 + term2)
}

# average
loss_per_year_binom_dev_avg <- function(D_obs, E_obs, q_hat) {
  dev_mat <- binom_deviance_cell(D_obs, E_obs, q_hat)
  colMeans(dev_mat, na.rm = TRUE)
}
```

## West
```{r}
# ── Set region here ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
reg      <- "West"   # change to "Midwest", "Northeast", or "South"

lc_res   <- LCfor_West       # change accordingly
rh_res   <- RH1021_West      # change accordingly
cbd_res  <- CBDfor_West      # change accordingly
reg_data <- region_data[["West"]]  # change accordingly
reg_data_CBD <- central2initial(region_data[["West"]])  # change accordingly

# ── Evaluation period ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_evalMonths <- lc_res$eval_time
evalMonths     <- all_evalMonths[all_evalMonths >= 2010 & all_evalMonths < 2020]
yr_char        <- as.character(evalMonths)

# ── Observed deaths and exposure ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ages_char <- as.character(25:65)
obs_death <- reg_data$Dxt[ages_char, yr_char, drop = FALSE]
obs_exp   <- reg_data$Ext[ages_char, yr_char, drop = FALSE]
obs_exp_CBD <- reg_data_CBD$Ext[ages_char, yr_char, drop = FALSE]

# ── Extract forecast mx ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# LC
mx_hat_lc <- lc_res$mx_hat_lc_rw[ages_char, yr_char, drop = FALSE]
# RH
mx_hat_rh <- rh_res$mx_hat_rh_ar[ages_char, yr_char, drop = FALSE]
# CBD
qx_hat_cbd <- cbd_res$qx_hat_CBD[ages_char, yr_char, drop = FALSE]

# ── Poisson deviance loss per year ────────────────────────────────────────────
L_lc  <- ts(as.numeric(loss_per_year_poisson_dev_avg(obs_death, obs_exp * mx_hat_lc)),
            start = min(evalMonths), frequency = 1)
L_rh  <- ts(as.numeric(loss_per_year_poisson_dev_avg(obs_death, obs_exp * mx_hat_rh)),
            start = min(evalMonths), frequency = 1)
L_cbd <- ts(as.numeric(loss_per_year_binom_dev_avg(obs_death, obs_exp_CBD, qx_hat_cbd)),
            start = min(evalMonths), frequency = 1)

# ── DM Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Region:", reg, "\n\n")

cat("-- LC vs RH --\n")
dm.test(as.numeric(L_lc), as.numeric(L_rh),
        alternative = "two.sided", h = 1, power = 1)

cat("-- LC vs CBD --\n")
dm.test(as.numeric(L_lc), as.numeric(L_cbd),
        alternative = "two.sided", h = 1, power = 1)

cat("-- RH vs CBD --\n")
dm.test(as.numeric(L_rh), as.numeric(L_cbd),
        alternative = "two.sided", h = 1, power = 1)
```

# Combine Model
```{r}
# load opioid related mortality rate
west_opioid_log <- as.matrix(read.csv("West_opioid_logmxt.csv", 
                                    row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
northeast_opioid_log <- as.matrix(read.csv("Northeast_opioid_logmxt.csv", 
                                    row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
midwest_opioid_log <- as.matrix(read.csv("Midwest_opioid_logmxt.csv", 
                                    row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
south_opioid_log <- as.matrix(read.csv("South_opioid_logmxt.csv", 
                                    row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
west_opioid <- exp(west_opioid_log)
northeast_opioid <- exp(northeast_opioid_log)
midwest_opioid <- exp(midwest_opioid_log)
south_opioid <- exp(south_opioid_log)

```

## LC
```{r}
# setting
ages      <- 25:65
out_years <- colnames(west_opioid)

# Extract Fitted Rate
fitted_lc_Midwest <- fitted(LCfit_Midwest, type = "rates")
fitted_lc_Northeast <- fitted(LCfit_Northeast, type = "rates")
fitted_lc_South <- fitted(LCfit_South, type = "rates")
fitted_lc_West <- fitted(LCfit_West, type = "rates")

# Subset to ages 25-65 and years 2003-2020 (monthly)
mx_base_lc_Midwest <- fitted_lc_Midwest[as.character(ages), as.character(out_years)]
mx_base_lc_Northeast <- fitted_lc_Northeast[as.character(ages), as.character(out_years)]
mx_base_lc_South <- fitted_lc_South[as.character(ages), as.character(out_years)]
mx_base_lc_West <- fitted_lc_West[as.character(ages), as.character(out_years)]


# combine two mortality
mxt_lc_Midwest <- mx_base_lc_Midwest + midwest_opioid
mxt_lc_Northeast <- mx_base_lc_Northeast + northeast_opioid
mxt_lc_South <- mx_base_lc_South + south_opioid
mxt_lc_West <- mx_base_lc_West + west_opioid

# ratio
ratio_lc_Midwest <- midwest_opioid / mxt_lc_Midwest
ratio_lc_Northeast <- northeast_opioid / mxt_lc_Northeast
ratio_lc_South <- south_opioid / mxt_lc_South
ratio_lc_West <- west_opioid / mxt_lc_West
```


```{r}
# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
regions <- c("Midwest", "Northeast", "South", "West")

ratio_list <- list(
  Midwest   = ratio_lc_Midwest,
  Northeast = ratio_lc_Northeast,
  South     = ratio_lc_South,
  West      = ratio_lc_West
)

# ── Build combined long format ────────────────────────────────────────────────
ratio_long_all <- lapply(regions, function(reg) {
  melt(ratio_list[[reg]],
       varnames   = c("Age", "Year"),
       value.name = "Ratio") %>%
    mutate(Region = reg)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ── Compute global max so all regions share the same scale ───────────────────
ratio_max   <- ceiling(max(ratio_long_all$Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) / 100
year_breaks <- unique(floor(ratio_long_all$Year))

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(ratio_long_all, aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = as.factor(Age), fill = Ratio)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low    = "white",
    high   = "red",
    limits = c(0, ratio_max),
    breaks = seq(0, ratio_max, by = 0.05),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    name   = "Opioid\nShare"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = as.character(year_breaks)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Opioid Mortality as Share of Total LC Mortality Rate (2003-2020)",
    x     = "Year",
    y     = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave("ratio_lc_all_regions.png", width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
# setting
ages     <- 25:65
out_years <- colnames(west_opioid)

# Extract Fitted Rate
fitted_rh_Midwest   <- fitted(RH_Midwest,   type = "rates")
fitted_rh_Northeast <- fitted(RH_Northeast, type = "rates")
fitted_rh_South     <- fitted(RH_South,     type = "rates")
fitted_rh_West      <- fitted(RH_West,      type = "rates")

# Divide column names by 12 to convert to decimal year
colnames(fitted_rh_Midwest)   <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_rh_Midwest))   / 12
colnames(fitted_rh_Northeast) <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_rh_Northeast)) / 12
colnames(fitted_rh_South)     <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_rh_South))     / 12
colnames(fitted_rh_West)      <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_rh_West))      / 12

# Divide row names by 12 to convert to age
rownames(fitted_rh_Midwest)   <- as.numeric(rownames(fitted_rh_Midwest))   / 12
rownames(fitted_rh_Northeast) <- as.numeric(rownames(fitted_rh_Northeast)) / 12
rownames(fitted_rh_South)     <- as.numeric(rownames(fitted_rh_South))     / 12
rownames(fitted_rh_West)      <- as.numeric(rownames(fitted_rh_West))      / 12

# Subset to ages 25-65 and years 2003-2020 (monthly)
mx_base_rh_Midwest   <- fitted_rh_Midwest[as.character(ages),   as.character(out_years)]
mx_base_rh_Northeast <- fitted_rh_Northeast[as.character(ages), as.character(out_years)]
mx_base_rh_South     <- fitted_rh_South[as.character(ages),     as.character(out_years)]
mx_base_rh_West      <- fitted_rh_West[as.character(ages),      as.character(out_years)]

# Combine two mortality
mxt_rh_Midwest   <- mx_base_rh_Midwest   + midwest_opioid
mxt_rh_Northeast <- mx_base_rh_Northeast + northeast_opioid
mxt_rh_South     <- mx_base_rh_South     + south_opioid
mxt_rh_West      <- mx_base_rh_West      + west_opioid

# Ratio
ratio_rh_Midwest   <- midwest_opioid   / mxt_rh_Midwest
ratio_rh_Northeast <- northeast_opioid / mxt_rh_Northeast
ratio_rh_South     <- south_opioid     / mxt_rh_South
ratio_rh_West      <- west_opioid      / mxt_rh_West
```

```{r}
# ── Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
regions <- c("Midwest", "Northeast", "South", "West")

ratio_list <- list(
  Midwest   = ratio_rh_Midwest,
  Northeast = ratio_rh_Northeast,
  South     = ratio_rh_South,
  West      = ratio_rh_West
)

# ── Build combined long format ────────────────────────────────────────────────
ratio_long_all <- lapply(regions, function(reg) {
  melt(ratio_list[[reg]],
       varnames   = c("Age", "Year"),
       value.name = "Ratio") %>%
    mutate(Region = reg)
}) %>% bind_rows()

# ── Compute global max ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ratio_max   <- ceiling(max(ratio_long_all$Ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100) / 100
year_breaks <- unique(floor(ratio_long_all$Year))

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(ratio_long_all, aes(x = as.factor(Year), y = as.factor(Age), fill = Ratio)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low    = "white",
    high   = "red",
    limits = c(0, ratio_max),
    breaks = seq(0, ratio_max, by = 0.05),
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    name   = "Opioid\nShare"
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    breaks = as.character(year_breaks)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Region, ncol = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Opioid Mortality as Share of Total RH Mortality Rate (2003-2020)",
    x     = "Year",
    y     = "Age"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.title      = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

ggsave("ratio_rh_all_regions.png", width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## CBD
```{r}
# setting
ages      <- 25:65
out_years <- colnames(west_opioid)

# Extract Fitted qx (one-year death probability)
fitted_cbd_Midwest   <- fitted(CBDfit_Midwest,   type = "rates")
fitted_cbd_Northeast <- fitted(CBDfit_Northeast, type = "rates")
fitted_cbd_South     <- fitted(CBDfit_South,     type = "rates")
fitted_cbd_West      <- fitted(CBDfit_West,      type = "rates")

# Divide column names by 12 to convert to decimal year
colnames(fitted_cbd_Midwest)   <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_cbd_Midwest))   / 12
colnames(fitted_cbd_Northeast) <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_cbd_Northeast)) / 12
colnames(fitted_cbd_South)     <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_cbd_South))     / 12
colnames(fitted_cbd_West)      <- as.numeric(colnames(fitted_cbd_West))      / 12

# Subset to ages 25-65 and years 2003-2020 (monthly)
qx_base_cbd_Midwest   <- fitted_cbd_Midwest[as.character(ages),   as.character(out_years)]
qx_base_cbd_Northeast <- fitted_cbd_Northeast[as.character(ages), as.character(out_years)]
qx_base_cbd_South     <- fitted_cbd_South[as.character(ages),     as.character(out_years)]
qx_base_cbd_West      <- fitted_cbd_West[as.character(ages),      as.character(out_years)]

# Convert qx to central mortality rate mx = qx / (1 - qx)
mx_base_cbd_Midwest   <- qx_base_cbd_Midwest   / (1 - qx_base_cbd_Midwest)
mx_base_cbd_Northeast <- qx_base_cbd_Northeast / (1 - qx_base_cbd_Northeast)
mx_base_cbd_South     <- qx_base_cbd_South     / (1 - qx_base_cbd_South)
mx_base_cbd_West      <- qx_base_cbd_West      / (1 - qx_base_cbd_West)

# Combine two mortality
mxt_cbd_Midwest   <- mx_base_cbd_Midwest   + midwest_opioid
mxt_cbd_Northeast <- mx_base_cbd_Northeast + northeast_opioid
mxt_cbd_South     <- mx_base_cbd_South     + south_opioid
mxt_cbd_West      <- mx_base_cbd_West      + west_opioid

# Ratio
ratio_cbd_Midwest   <- midwest_opioid   / mxt_cbd_Midwest
ratio_cbd_Northeast <- northeast_opioid / mxt_cbd_Northeast
ratio_cbd_South     <- south_opioid     / mxt_cbd_South
ratio_cbd_West      <- west_opioid      / mxt_cbd_West
```
